Fereshteh,
I'm extremely sorry for the delay.
I reviewed the code and found out that registerTwitterOAuth() was no longer supported on my R console. I'm on R 3.1.2.I used setup_twitter_oauth() with the needed parameters instead.
There's no greying issue now in the deployed app on shinyapps.io :).

- Going through the result showLogs(),I found out that the "Yes" object was of another shinyapp that I'd just recently tried to deploy!

-The author's URL to the deployed application is https://dipanjan.shinyapps.io/twitter-analysis/
Unfortunately,this app is unavailable to me now.I presume because of exceeded usage.

In the code,in order to show the raw tweets in a tabular fashion,RenderTable() is used.But this doesn't display all of the tweets.Many a times,out of 30,only 19 or so are displayed.
Is there any way,I can correct this?
I'm attaching the code and a snapshot of the deployed application.

Rini
